carbon_policy_signal.item: Italy leads push to weaken EU green rules in €2 trillion budget; US oil lobbying for climate-rule dilution and CBAM enforcement delay.
carbon_policy_signal.why_it_matters: Weakening decarbonization targets and CBAM enforcement delay remove carbon floor; slower renewable capex extends thermal baseload demand but reduces long-term carbon scarcity value. EUA downside risk into Cal+1 and beyond.

freshness_caveat: Coal data stale (196 days old, as of 2025-12-26); Clean Dark stale (191 days old, as of 2025-12-31). Coal 7th-pctile and Clean Dark 48th-pctile readings may not reflect current spreads. All forward-looking signals rely on fresh GB Power, DE Power, TTF, Storage, Renewables, EUA (all ≤2 days old).
risk_flags: Storage at 51.1% (15pp below 5-yr seasonal) with refill pace slowing into Aug—H2 power curve at risk if summer demand extends or winter fill disappoints.
Iran sanctions reimposed and Italy leading EU green-rules weakening—TTF upside via LNG scarcity but EUA downside via decarbonization stall; conflicting signals for thermal dispatch.
Clean Spark 55.3 EUR/MWh (96th-pctile) vs Clean Dark at 48th-pctile—gas clearly dominating coal; coal at 7th-pctile (96 USD/t) may not support dispatch reversion even if power peaks.
Renewables at 46.5% of load (60th-pctile) after -32.5% daily drop—weak wind/solar forecast means higher thermal baseload requirement; GB premium widening reflects import scarcity.

base.summary: Storage refill neutral; renewables recover to 50–55% of load; geopolitical priced in; GB power settles 80–90 EUR/MWh, DE 150–160.

downside.summary: EU green-rules strengthened; renewables surge (wind recovery to 70%+ of load); storage refill accelerates; Russia LNG fleet repairs ease global LNG spot. TTF −5–7%, GB −10–15%, DE −8–12%.

upside.summary: Iran sanctions tighten MENA LNG supply; EU green-rules weakening stalls renewable capex; storage refill misses 1–2pp; cold snap drives Aug demand. TTF +8–12%, GB +15–20%, DE +10–15%.

themes: Extreme GB/DE power; coal structurally sidelined
Storage deficit constrains H2 refill; gas-to-power switching priced in
Geopolitical tail-risk: Iran sanctions, green-rules rollback, Russian refinery outages
EUA flat despite policy headwinds; carbon floor under pressure
top_drivers: Storage deficit (51.1%, -15pp seasonal) forcing higher thermal reliance into H2; refill pace and winter adequacy now front-of-mind for Cal+1 curve.
GB power at 97th-pctile amid weak renewables (-32.5% daily) and import scarcity; interconnector bottleneck and Irish wind forecast critical.
Geopolitical regime shift: Iran sanctions re-impose LNG scarcity and Brent upside, supporting gas-to-power switching; Italy/EU green-rules rollback dilutes carbon floor and EUA downside risk.
Clean Spark 96th-pctile, Clean Dark 48th-pctile—gas structurally in-the-money; coal sidelined at 7th-pctile, no dispatch recovery even on price.
top_takeaway: GB Power at 97th-percentile; Clean Spark 96th-pctile; storage 15pp below seasonal average; Iran sanctions and green-rule rollback risk tighten thermal merit order amid weak renewables backdrop.

watchlist.metric: Storage refill pace vs H2 demand
watchlist.why: 51.1% full, 15pp below seasonal; delayed refill into Aug-Sep will set winter adequacy and Cal+1 power premium.
Tightens Brent and global LNG spot; watch MENA cargoes for NW Europe TTF vs Asia premium; TTF upside if MENA supply redirected.
Italy/Sweden standoff on carbon targets; weakening risks EUA downside via slower decarbonization and stalled CBAM enforcement.
Diesel export halt constrains global supply; spillover to EU crude-for-product swaps and indirect power fuel economics.
GB at 141.96 EUR/MWh (97th-pctile) vs DE at 167.73 (83rd-pctile, up 35% day-on-day)—interconnector flows and import scarcity are critical; watch for flash price events.
